text: Lets you test any MCP server directly from your browser, supporting all MCP features
quote: Test any MCP server from your browser. Supports every Model Context Protocol feature

text: Can build a server image straight from a connected GitHub repository
quote: Connect a GitHub repository and Glama builds the image straight from source.

text: Supports deploying via Dockerfile, npm package, or PyPI module with configurable build steps and runtime versions
quote: Ship a Dockerfile, an npm package, or a PyPI module. Configure Node or Python versions, build steps, and CMD arguments – or let Glama infer them.

text: Routes every MCP tool call from your agents through the platform so you can see and control what the AI does
quote: Every MCP call from your agents flows through Glama – so you know exactly what your AI is doing, and you decide what it's allowed to do.

text: Provides per-tool access control to enable or disable individual tools
quote: Per-tool access control – enable or disable individual tools

text: Offers a curated, searchable catalog of open-source servers and remote connectors with inspectable capabilities
quote: Search Glama's curated catalog of open-source servers and remote connectors, inspect their capabilities, and keep your own directory synchronized.

text: Lets you expose a local MCP server via a public tunnel (mcp-proxy) so it can be tested with the hosted inspector
quote: Test your local MCP servers with the inspector by exposing them via a public tunnel using mcp-proxy.

text: Server listings are private by default and can be switched to public when ready
quote: Private by default – flip to public listing when ready.

text: Supports automating workflows via schedules or webhooks
quote: Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks.
